rationale: Measured 2026-09-29: on the protected camera11 diagnostic, det2b (1 global GAP token) reached 27.27% specificity, det6a (64 local 8x8 tokens) 18.18%, det5a (16 local 4x4 tokens) 9.09%, while every one of them had a higher Val accuracy than det2b. More local tokens did not help, so the Authentic signal looks global. Every candidate here trains on the already-computed 64-token Det6 cache, so the loop needs no new precompute. The first block tests the aggregation hypothesis; the second block tunes the two settings that historically moved camera11 the most (hard-negative loss weight, seed variance).

protocol.note: Screening numbers rank candidates against each other only. Screening Val accuracy is NOT comparable to full-data Val accuracy and is never used to accept a candidate; the external diagnostics are the gate.

candidates.name: s00_control_patch_attention_8x8
candidates.note: Screening control. Same architecture as det6a but on the 25k subsample, so every other row is comparable to it.

candidates.name: s01_token_stats
candidates.note: Primary test of the global-aggregation hypothesis: mean/max/std over the 64 local tokens.

candidates.name: s02_token_stats_coarse
candidates.note: Same reduction after 2x2 coarse pooling, suppresses single-token noise before the statistics.

candidates.name: s03_spatial_pyramid
candidates.note: Explicit interpolation between det2b (1 token) and det6a (64 tokens): pool 8x8 down to 4x4/2x2/1x1 and concatenate.

candidates.name: s04_token_stats_topk
candidates.note: Statistics of the top-4 tokens by learned patch score: keeps the sparse-local-evidence idea but classifies globally.

candidates.name: s05_token_stats_topk8
candidates.note: Same with a wider top-k to see whether the top-k width matters.

candidates.name: s06_token_stats_do03
candidates.note: More regularisation; det4c showed dropout 0.3 slightly beat 0.2 on Val.

candidates.name: s07_token_stats_lr3e4
candidates.note: Higher LR, the value used by the det2b/det4 runs that set the current best Val.

candidates.name: s08_token_stats_seed7
candidates.note: Seed variance check. Det5 multiseed showed all three seeds failed camera11, so a single lucky seed must not be mistaken for a fix.

candidates.name: s09_token_stats_hardneg15
candidates.note: Loss weight 1.5 on the 591 audit-verified zero-mask Authentic hard negatives. det5g got 86.38% Val from this but no external diagnostic was opened.

candidates.name: s10_patch_attention_hardneg15
candidates.note: Same hard-negative weighting on the control architecture, so the weighting effect can be separated from the aggregation effect.

candidates.name: s11_spatial_pyramid_do03_lr3e4
candidates.note: Combination of the two best-known regularisation settings on the pyramid head.
